# We use CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH instead of CMAKE_SKIP_RPATH because the former makes it so that we use rpath
# during building and linking but strip it when installing. This means we can link ldc against the runtime we just built.
function ldc_configure() {
    %cmake \
       -DADDITIONAL_DEFAULT_LDC_SWITCHES="\"-link-defaultlib-shared\"," \
       -DBASH_COMPLETION_COMPLETIONSDIR="%(completionsdir)" \
       -DBUILD_LTO_LIBS=ON \
       -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=BOTH \
       -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \

       -DLDC_DYNAMIC_COMPILE=OFF \
       -DLDC_INSTALL_LTOPLUGIN=ON \
       -DLDC_WITH_LLD=ON \
       -DLLVM_CONFIG=%(bindir)/llvm-config-22 \
       -DPHOBOS_SYSTEM_ZLIB=ON \
       "$@"
}

    ldc_configure \
        -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld" \
        -DD_COMPILER=%(buildroot)/ldc/bootstrap/bin/ldmd2
else
    ldc_configure \
        -DD_COMPILER_FLAGS="-link-defaultlib-shared=false --flto=thin"
fi

libarchive.setup:
mkdir libarchive libarchive-static
# This could use tar if we needed to rebootstrap
bsdtar-static -xf %(sourcedir)/libarchive.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C libarchive
bsdtar-static -xf %(sourcedir)/libarchive.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C libarchive-static

function libarchive_configure() {
    %patch %(pkgdir)/0001-Add-stone-read-support.patch
    %patch %(pkgdir)/0001-Exclude-boulder-broken-test.patch

    %reconfigure \
        --disable-rpath \
        --with-lzo2 \
        --with-libstone \
        "$@"
}

pushd libarchive
    libarchive_configure \
        --disable-static \
        --enable-shared
popd

# Statically link in libxml2 and libicu since those are the libraries most likely to change sonames
# libstone doesn't yet have a stable ABI and it's not needed so don't bother supporting it here.
pushd libarchive-static
    libarchive_configure \
        --enable-bsdcpio=static \
        --enable-static \
        --disable-bsdcat \
        --disable-bsdcpio \
        --disable-bsdunzip \
        --disable-shared \
        --without-libstone \
        LIBXML2_PC_LIBS="$(pkg-config --variable=libdir libxml-2.0)/libxml2.a $(pkg-config --variable=libdir icu-uc)/libicuuc.a $(pkg-config --variable=libdir icu-uc)/libicudata.a -lstdc++ -lm" \
        ac_cv_lib_xml2_xmlInitParser=yes
popd
libarchive.build:
for i in libarchive-static libarchive; do
    cat ${i}/Makefile
    %ccache_zero
    env CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}/${i}" %make -C ${i} V=1
    %ccache_stats
done
libarchive.install:
%make_install -C libarchive-static

# Preserve bsdtar-static
mv %(installroot)/%(bindir)/bsdtar %(installroot)/%(bindir)/bsdtar-static

%make_install -C libarchive

ln -sv bsdtar.1 %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1/bsdtar-static.1

# We don't (yet) need libarchive.a for anything else
rm -v %(installroot)/%(libdir)/libarchive.a
libarchive.check:
# Note, the test suite MUST succeed at all times

# This skips a file descriptor test that fails in boulder. We may need to change how /tmp is mounted
export SKIP_OPEN_FD_ERR_TEST=1

%make -C libarchive check || (cat /tmp/*_test*/*.log && exit 1)

# "Inspired by"/"Gratuitously copied from" Gentoo, use LLVM_DISTRIBUTION_COMPONENTS to avoid installing static libs
# and other unnecessary things. This works by extracting the target list from ninja and
# filtering it to only have the things we really need. This way when cmake target files
# are generated it results in the components we didn't include not being added to the
# searched for objects.
## NOTE: New versions of LLVM should be built without this in order to see what's been
## added/removed and this list updated correspondingly.
function get_distribution_components() {
    # This generates a lot of output that we don't need to see
    set +x
    local target
    ninja -C "%(builddir)" -t targets | grep -Po 'install-\K.*(?=-stripped:)' | while read -r target; do
        case $target in
            distribution)
                continue
                ;;

            ### LLVM
            llvm-libraries)
                continue
                ;;
            # shared libraries
            LLVM|LLVMgold|LTO|Remarks)
                ;;
            # Used by LDC
            LLVMTableGen|LLVMSupport|LLVMDemangle)
                ;;
            # Devel
            llvm-headers|cmake-exports)
                ;;
            # Bins
            FileCheck|UnicodeNameMappingGenerator|dsymutil|llc|lli|llubi|obj2yaml|opt|opt-viewer|reduce-chunk-list|sancov|sanstats|split-file|verify-uselistorder|yaml2obj)
                ;;
            # Devel bins

                ;;

            ### BOLT
            bolt)
                ;;

            ### MLIR
            mlir-libraries)
                continue
                ;;
            # Shared libs
            MLIR|MLIR-C|MLIRExecutionEngineShared)
                ;;
            # Target libs
            mlir_*)
                ;;
            # MLIR tools

            # Devel
            mlir-headers|mlir-cmake-exports)

            # Fortran build files
            flang-binding|flang-module-interfaces|flang-fortran-binding)
                ;;

            ### built-ins, Runtimes
            builtins|runtimes)
                ;;

            ### Deny everything else
            *)
                continue
                ;;
        esac
        echo $target
    done

# "Inspired by"/"Gratuitously copied from" Gentoo, use LLVM_DISTRIBUTION_COMPONENTS to avoid installing static libs
# and other unnecessary things. This works by extracting the target list from ninja and
# filtering it to only have the things we really need. This way when cmake target files
# are generated it results in the components we didn't include not being added to the
# searched for objects.
## NOTE: New versions of LLVM should be built without this in order to see what's been
## added/removed and this list updated correspondingly.
function get_distribution_components() {
    # This generates a lot of output that we don't need to see
    set +x
    local target
    ninja -C "%(builddir)" -t targets | grep -Po 'install-\K.*(?=-stripped:)' | while read -r target; do
        case $target in
            distribution)
                continue
                ;;

            ### LLVM
            llvm-libraries)
                continue
                ;;
            # shared libraries
            LLVM|LLVMgold|LTO|Remarks)
                ;;
            # Used by LDC
            LLVMTableGen|LLVMSupport|LLVMDemangle|LLVMDebuginfod)
                ;;
            # Devel
            llvm-headers|cmake-exports)
                ;;
            # Bins
            FileCheck|UnicodeNameMappingGenerator|bugpoint|dsymutil|llc|lli|obj2yaml|opt|opt-viewer|reduce-chunk-list|sancov|sanstats|split-file|verify-uselistorder|yaml2obj)
                ;;
            # Devel bins
            count|lli-child-target|not|yaml-bench)
                ;;
            # Various binaries (everything we don't want has already been excluded)
            llvm-*)
                ;;

            ### Clang
            clang-libraries)
                continue
                ;;
            clang-tidy-headers)
                continue
                ;;
            # Libs
            libclang|clang-cpp)
                ;;
            clang|clangd|clang-*|bash-autocomplete)
                ;;
            # Other clang tools
            amdgpu-arch|c-index-test|diagtool|find-all-symbols|hmaptool|modularize|nvptx-arch|pp-trace|scan-view|scan-build*)
                ;;
            clang*|findAllSymbols)
                continue
                ;;

            ### LLD
            # Shared libraries
            lld*)
                ;;
            # Devel
            lld-headers|lld-cmake-exports)
                ;;

            ### built-ins, Runtimes
            builtins|runtimes)
                ;;

            ### Deny everything else
            *)
                continue
                ;;
        esac
        echo $target
    done
    set -x
}

# and other unnecessary things. This works by extracting the target list from ninja and
# filtering it to only have the things we really need. This way when cmake target files
# are generated it results in the components we didn't include not being added to the
# searched for objects.
## NOTE: New versions of LLVM should be built without this in order to see what's been
## added/removed and this list updated correspondingly.
function get_distribution_components() {
    # This generates a lot of output that we don't need to see
    set +x
    local target
    ninja -C "%(builddir)" -t targets | grep -Po 'install-\K.*(?=-stripped:)' | while read -r target; do
        case $target in
            distribution)
                continue
                ;;

            ### LLVM
            llvm-libraries)
                continue
                ;;
            # shared libraries
            LLVM|LLVMgold|LTO|Remarks)
                ;;
            # Used by LDC
            LLVMTableGen|LLVMSupport|LLVMDemangle|LLVMDebuginfod)
                ;;
            # Devel
            llvm-headers|cmake-exports)
                ;;
            # Bins
            FileCheck|UnicodeNameMappingGenerator|bugpoint|dsymutil|llc|lli|obj2yaml|opt|opt-viewer|reduce-chunk-list|sancov|sanstats|split-file|verify-uselistorder|yaml2obj)
                ;;
            # Devel bins
            count|lli-child-target|not|yaml-bench)
                ;;
            # Various binaries (everything we don't want has already been excluded)
            llvm-*)
                ;;

            ### Clang
            clang-libraries)
                continue
                ;;
            clang-tidy-headers)
                continue
                ;;
            # Libs
            libclang|clang-cpp)
                ;;
            clang|clangd|clang-*|bash-autocomplete)
                ;;
            # Other clang tools
            c-index-test|diagtool|find-all-symbols|hmaptool|modularize|offload-arch|pp-trace|scan-view|scan-build*)
                ;;
            clang*|findAllSymbols)
                continue
                ;;

            ### LLD
            # Shared libraries
            lld|lld-libraries)
                ;;
            # Devel
            lld-headers|lld-cmake-exports)
                ;;

            ### LLDB
            # bin
            lldb|lldb-python-scripts|lldb-argdumper|lldb-dap|lldb-instr|lldb-server)
                ;;
            # libs
            liblldb|lldbIntelFeatures)
                ;;
            # Devel
            lldb-headers)
                ;;

            ### Polly
            # Libs
            Polly|PollyISL|LLVMPolly)
                ;;
            # Devel
            polly-headers|polly-cmake-exports)
                ;;

            ### BOLT
            bolt)
                ;;

            ### MLIR
            mlir-libraries)
                continue
                ;;
            # Shared libs
            MLIR|MLIR-C|MLIRExecutionEngineShared)
                ;;
            # Target libs
            mlir_*)
                ;;
            # MLIR tools
            mlir-*|tblgen-lsp-server|tblgen-to-irdl)
                ;;
            # Devel
            mlir-headers|mlir-cmake-exports)
                ;;
            # MLIR dependencies
            MLIRSparseTensorRuntime|MLIRSparseTensorEnums)
                ;;

            ### Flang
            # Flang itself
            flang)
                ;;
            # Supporting tools
            bbc|tco|f18-parse-demo|fir-*)
                ;;
            # Fortran build files
            flang-binding|flang-module-interfaces|flang-fortran-binding)
                ;;

            ### built-ins, Runtimes
            builtins|runtimes)
                ;;

            ### Deny everything else
            *)
                continue
                ;;
        esac
        echo $target
    done
    set -x
}

            c-index-test|diagtool|find-all-symbols|hmaptool|modularize|offload-arch|pp-trace|scan-view|scan-build*)
                ;;
            clang*|findAllSymbols)
                continue
                ;;

            ### LLD
            # Shared libraries
            lld|lld-libraries)
                ;;
            # Devel
            lld-headers|lld-cmake-exports)
                ;;

            ### LLDB
            # bin
            lldb|lldb-python-scripts|lldb-argdumper|lldb-dap|lldb-instr|lldb-mcp|lldb-server)
                ;;
            # libs
            liblldb|lldbIntelFeatures)
                ;;
            # Devel
            lldb-headers)
                ;;

            ### Polly
            # Libs
            Polly|PollyISL|LLVMPolly)
                ;;
            # Devel
            polly-headers|polly-cmake-exports)
                ;;

            ### BOLT
            bolt)
                ;;

            ### MLIR
            mlir-libraries)
                continue
                ;;
            # Shared libs
            MLIR|MLIR-C|MLIRExecutionEngineShared)
                ;;
            # Target libs
            mlir_*)
                ;;
            # MLIR tools
            mlir-*|tblgen-lsp-server|tblgen-to-irdl)
                ;;
            # Devel
            mlir-headers|mlir-cmake-exports)
                ;;
            # MLIR dependencies
            MLIRSparseTensorRuntime|MLIRSparseTensorEnums)
                ;;

            ### Flang
            # Flang itself
            flang)
                ;;
            # Supporting tools
            bbc|tco|f18-parse-demo|fir-*)
                ;;
            # Fortran build files
            flang-binding|flang-module-interfaces|flang-fortran-binding)
                ;;

            ### built-ins, Runtimes
            builtins|runtimes)
                ;;

            ### Deny everything else
            *)
                continue
                ;;
        esac
        echo $target
    done
    set -x
}
